_layer: STATIC — the 5 shots, fixed order. {placeholders} are filled from the dynamic layer.

shots.purpose: Shopify main image and collection thumbnail
shots.camera: eye level to 15 degrees above, straight-on front or slight 3/4 turn; 85-100mm product-lens look
shots.framing: product centred, 60-75% of frame, full product visible
shots.set: clean seamless or single-surface backdrop in {hero_backdrop}; soft contact shadow
shots.props: none (max 1 tiny brand-world accent only if brand allows)

shots.purpose: show how and where the product is used
shots.camera: 30-45 degrees above, natural eye-line of the user
shots.framing: product 35-55%, in active use, still the brightest and sharpest element
shots.human: {human_mode}: hands | partial person | none (show the result of use instead)
shots.depth_of_field: medium — background softly out of focus

shots.mode_rule: if category.material_is_visual = true -> MACRO; else -> FEATURE CALLOUT

macro.framing: {detail_focus} fills 70-90% of frame, rest of product implied
macro.set: same surface as shot 2, very shallow depth of field

feature_callout.framing: product 45-55% on one side, clean space on the other
feature_callout.set: plain backdrop; leave space for 3-4 callouts added as overlay in post (NOT generated by the image model)

shots.purpose: show the whole product, contents or other side from a new angle
shots.camera: 90 degrees top-down flat-lay OR 45 degrees high angle — pick the one not used in shot 2
shots.framing: product group 40-60%, items spaced on a loose grid, clear gaps between items
shots.content_rule: sets/kits: lay out the contents next to the open pack; single items: show open/closed or front/back pair

shots.purpose: social and storytelling image; the brand mood
shots.camera: free — 30-60 degrees, can be wider; editorial composition
shots.framing: product 35-50%, on a rule-of-thirds point, 15-25% clean negative space for text
shots.depth_of_field: shallow — background and outer props soft
